name: simulens
description: Uncertainty-Aware Causal World Model & Intervention Simulation Engine

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@simulens/shared && npm run build --workspace=@simulens/simulation-engine && npm run build --workspace=@simulens/world-model && npm run build --workspace=@simulens/reasoning-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@simulens/api && npm run build --workspace=@simulens/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@simulens/simulation-engine && npm run test --workspace=@simulens/reasoning-engine && npm run test --workspace=@simulens/api
